title: IV fluid tonicity

findings.where: Images 1, 2, 8 and 9, introductory definition; TonicityDiagram Frame.desc
findings.title: “Cannot cross” drops an important qualification
findings.problem: The diagram says effective solute “cannot cross into the cell,” while the captions correctly say “can't freely cross” on the relevant timescale. Effective osmoles need not be absolutely membrane-impermeant: sodium and chloride cross through channels and transporters but do not freely equilibrate. The absolute wording also makes the later glucose exception harder to reconcile.
findings.fix: Use “effective solute: does not freely equilibrate across the cell membrane” and retain the timescale qualification in the accessible description.

assessment: Minor revision needed: the visible effective-solute definition overstates membrane impermeability.
